remarks: A wonderful lifestyle awaits at Birchwood Condos. Maintenance worries melt away and peaceful living takes center stage. Nestled on the border of Westport and Norwalk, this serene condo offers the perfect blend of tranquility and convenience. Just off Westport Avenue and across the street from Whole Foods! Step inside this sundrenched, spacious condo and you will immediately notice the numerous updates: new luxurious flooring, new carpet, new HVAC unit, expansive windows, open floor plan, calming private Zen Garden! This 3 bedroom condo is, in my opinion, in the perfect location... close to the pool and club house (short walk to the pool gate), entrance to the complex, reserved covered garage spot and large storage unit in basement, with access just across the hall. Plenty of open guest parking available. Please see attached Improvements List. Birchwood is in a Special Service District with Westport address. Birchwood Condos mailing address is Westport but Norwalk amenities.(schools, beaches and taxes) HOA TOTAL are $553.77 (HOA is $288.85 SSD is $264.92) Current assessment is 152.68 - ends October 2025
